title: 空置楼层与租金让步
prompt: Black-and-white observational documentary footage for a serious economics explainer. Neutral grayscale silver-gelatin photography, detailed faces and material textures, soft daylight, moderate contrast, clear readable composition. Original illustrative reconstruction. Natural restrained gestures, physically coherent objects and hands. Landscape 16:9. One continuous shot, gentle camera movement only. No subtitles, no readable lettering, no logos, no watermark, no graphic overlays. Slow lateral wide shot across a nearly empty contemporary office floor. Many unoccupied desk positions and disconnected monitors. At one side an East Asian property manager shows a revised lease folder to a prospective tenant, who considers it but hesitates. Broad daylight, vacancy rather than ruined or collapsed architecture.
